question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The apple tasted incredibly **__sweet__**.
solution:
The correct answer is "Bitter."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Sweet" means containing, or tasting as if it contains, a lot of sugar. (मधुर, मीठा (चीनी भरा), मीठा या मधुर लगने वाला)

 
 
• Example: *The pineapple was **sweet**__ and juicy.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of "Sweet" is "Bitter."
 
• The word "Bitter" means with an unpleasantly sharp taste. (एक अप्रिय तीखे स्वाद के साथ)
 __
 
• Example: *That food has a **bitter**__ flavour.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Delicious: **having a very pleasant taste or smell. (स्‍वादिष्‍ट या सुगंधित)
 
• **Pleasant: **nice, enjoyable or friendly. (सुहाना, आनंददायक या अनुकूल)
 
• **Special: **not usual or ordinary; important for some particular reason. (प्रायः होने वाला या साधारण नहीं, विशेष; किसी ख़ास कारण से महत्वपूर्ण)

3d:T1542,

The correct answer is "waive."
